gjort: Six image ads that had been stuck since 2026-09-17 are now live in CARASHELL_NO_Takovertrekket, one ad set per concept, all read back ACTIVE.
Norwegian prices throughout: 1 106 kr, was 1 382,50 kr, save 276,50 kr = 20 %. The Swedish 23 % was never carried across.
All six link to /nb/products/takskyddet?country=NO, so Norwegian buyers see NOK and not SEK.
HeyGen credits used: 0 before -> 0 after. Images are translated pixel by pixel, no credits.
All six Notion rows moved to Approved - both NO and US now carry the ad.
varningar: The store name was taken out of the Norwegian copy before upload. Four body texts said 'CaraShell covers only the roof' or '16 reviews at carashell.se', and PD_6_1's bottom band said 'carashell.se - Free shipping - 14 days return'. An ad must never carry the store name, because the same ad is mirrored between stores. The 16-review claim still stands, just without naming where the reviews sit.

Two real faults were found and fixed in the image translator: it could not paint a bar in a colour the image already uses, and a 3 px erase margin left a readable ghost line under large bold text (measured on PD_7_1's bottom band: 13 % contrast left on 10 % of the pixels). Both now have their own setting.
Two faults reported on 2026-09-17 did not exist: the star row must simply be left alone rather than redrawn, and the price chip needs a manual box rather than a new detector.
action_axel: The video PD_5_H1 is held and was not uploaded. Three things block it, all measured in the source file: Swedish word captions are burned into the whole video and HeyGen only translates the audio; the end card is a screenshot of the Swedish product page showing 1 469,00 kr to 1 129,00 kr, while Norway pays 1 106 kr; and both the caption and the voiceover say the store name. The US run on 2026-09-18 rebuilt exactly this for English, so the path exists - but it puts the store name back into the ad, and after your decision on 2026-09-18 that is your call, not the routine's. Tell us which way to go and the video ships the same day. The row stays in SE-ACTIVE to be translated until then.
